title: Summary of Terms — Dividends and Preferred Purchase Settlement across the Member Equities & Patronage Classes
content:
Of the six Member Equities & Patronage classes, only Class H Preferred Stock earns dividends and is bought by members on their own purchase order. This summary states the dividend terms and the preferred purchase settlement and quarterly purchase figures of every class.

## Summary of terms

| | Class C Participation Certificate | Class A Nonvoting Common Stock | Class B Voting Stock | Qualified Allocated Surplus | Nonqualified Allocated Surplus | Class H Preferred Stock |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Earns dividends | No | No | No | No | No | Yes |
| Annual dividend rate currently declared by the board (%) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 4.25 |
| How often dividends are declared and paid | None | None | None | None | None | Quarterly |
| Dividends may be reinvested in additional shares | No | No | No | No | No | Yes |
| Which shares earn a quarter's dividend | None | None | None | None | None | Average daily shares held in the quarter |
| Business days after the purchase funds clear before preferred shares are issued (0 = not applicable) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 2 |
| Most preferred stock a member may buy in one calendar quarter (USD; 0 = not applicable) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 250000 |

## Points of the summary

- **What is the declared annual dividend rate of Class H Preferred Stock?** 4.25 percent per year, as currently declared by the board, with dividends declared and paid quarterly.
- **May a preferred stockholder take shares instead of cash?** Yes. Class H Preferred Stock is the one class whose dividends may be reinvested in additional shares.
- **When are newly bought preferred shares issued?** 2 business days after the purchase funds clear.
- **What is the most a member may buy in one calendar quarter?** USD 250000 of Class H Preferred Stock.
- Borrower equity and allocated surplus earn no dividend, so the dividend columns for those classes show none.
